steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ directly on its Project Details summary page.
Ensure eRFX projects are enabled as required by the setup.
Confirm the browser is on the Project Details summary screen.
Check that the project metadata section exposes the Project ID.
Check that the project metadata section exposes its creation timestamp.
Check that the published-stage section is present.
Check that the stage table exposes the RFQ stage-code column.
Check that the stage table exposes the stage-title column.
Check that the stage table exposes pending actions.
Check that participant information is shown for the published stage.
Check that the stage table shows the bidding start field.
Check that the stage table shows the bidding end field.
Check that the quotation-template section is present.
Check that template download actions are exposed.
Check that the terms-and-conditions section is present.
Confirm the Project Details screen has no rendering errors, raw values, or server failures.
